question: Which restaurant won the 2026 James Beard Award for Outstanding Restaurant?
answer: Kalaya in Philadelphia, PA won the 2026 James Beard Award for Outstanding Restaurant, announced June 15, 2026 at the Lyric Opera of Chicago [1][2]. It beat the other nominees: The Catbird Seat, The Four Horsemen, Mixtli and Vicia [3].

keyPoints.text: The 2026 Outstanding Restaurant award (presented by Acqua Panna) went to Kalaya in Philadelphia, PA.
The winners were announced Monday, June 15, 2026 at the Lyric Opera of Chicago.
Kalaya was one of five nominees for Outstanding Restaurant, alongside The Catbird Seat, The Four Horsemen, Mixtli, and Vicia.
Bon Appétit's winners list also names Kalaya, Philadelphia for Outstanding Restaurant.
